critiques.summary: Read the Session 3 working tree end to end via the copilot-cli agentic transport with the read-only tool allowlist: the four re-authored specs, the retired planning note, the two new corpus tests, and spec_admission/_discover_specs. Confirmed the Set 118 A4.1 deletion analysis and the restructurings, and found one Major: the new corpus test iterates _discover_specs without asserting it returned anything, so an empty discovery would let it pass having checked nothing -- the exact L-112-1 shape this set exists to prevent. Two non-blocking nits on the 118 re-read ratio band and a change-log falsifier count.

findings.description: Violation: the class docstring claims "only a test keeps it true", but test_no_unstarted_spec_in_the_repo_requires_restructuring iterates sa._discover_specs(str(repo_root)) with no guard that the list is non-empty. Impact: if _discover_specs ever returns [] for the real repo (a path change, a directory rename, a discovery refactor), offenders stays {} and the assertion passes having examined zero specs -- a gate that only ever passes is indistinguishable from one that checks nothing, and the Set 112/127 incident recurs unnoticed. Evidence: ai_router/spec_admission.py:688 returns [] immediately when docs/session-sets is absent; ai_router/tests/test_spec_admission_shape.py starts its loop directly. The sibling test test_that_scan_can_actually_fail DOES carry the guard (assert specs) but runs against tmp_path, not repo_root, so it does not close the gap. Fix: assert the discovery result is non-empty before the loop.

critiques.summary: Independently read run_of_record.classify_changed_paths, post_round_delta.classify_delta, the full new test file, spec_admission (restructuring_required, _discover_specs, _STARTED_STATUSES), all four re-authored specs, decisions.jsonl and change-log.md. CONFIRMED the A4.1 collision independently: classify_changed_paths classifies by path prefix over output that does include deleted files, so deleted test paths classify as test-only and DELTA_TEST_ONLY does not trigger owes_review -- the spec analysis and remedy are correct. Re-computed the change-log arithmetic (+56/day = 168/3; 0.99 = 67,182/67,634) and found it consistent, and found every RESOLVED marker in the retired note names a concrete deliverable. Found the same vacuous-pass gap as the other critic, graded Minor.

findings.description: Violation: neither new test guards that sa._discover_specs(str(repo_root)) returns a non-empty list; _discover_specs returns [] immediately if docs/session-sets does not exist. Impact: a future refactor that moves specs or renames the directory gives a green corpus test while scanning nothing. Evidence: ai_router/spec_admission.py:688 (if not os.path.isdir(base): return []) against the unguarded loop in ai_router/tests/test_spec_admission_shape.py; the falsifier sibling plants into tmp_path and so cannot close the gap on the repo_root scan. Fix: assert the discovered list before iterating.
